sourceEvidence.label: SCAMTRACE decision pipeline, safety documentation, and prototype reports

assessment.summary: The local prototype needs a first-class attack narrative and intervention protocol to become defensible beyond generic call-scam classification.

nonNegotiables: No cloud inference or raw-audio persistence in the core path.
No caller criminality or scam-probability claim.
Voice authenticity cannot decide an alert on its own.
Interventions must be understandable under pressure.
assumptions: The system remains a local Python and browser application in this phase.
Representative real-call evaluation and a validated anti-spoof model are not yet available.

opportunities.title: Make the decision layer an evidence ledger and counter-pressure protocol
opportunities.summary: Turn timestamped tactic evidence into bounded attack-playbook alignment, explicit uncertainty, and threat-family-specific safe exits.
opportunities.diagnosis: Current components explain tactics but do not own an attack path, a decision-reversal condition, or a response tailored to the active coercion.

evidence.claim: The orchestration result exposes tactics, progression and fusion independently.
Tactic matching is direct and auditable but needs an explicit polarity guard.
Current evaluation cannot support field-accuracy or deepfake claims.
An evidence-and-intervention moat is needed because on-device scam classification is already available in a major phone platform.

desiredInvariants: Every alert exposes timestamped, user-readable evidence and the unsafe action it seeks to prevent.
A high-severity response requires a direct extraction/control request, a coherent bounded attack path, or both.
The response gives a safe independent-verification action and a fact that would lower concern.
Voice authenticity can raise scrutiny but cannot independently create a scam alert.

options.title: Strengthen the existing rule-and-score pipeline
options.summary: Add more normalisation, phrases and negation guards while keeping the current response shape.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Tactical lexical resilience improves but no narrative owner is created.

tradeoffs.assessment: Reduces known phrase errors, but decision ownership stays split.
No new service or model lifecycle.

residualRisks: The product still presents a score rather than a defensible attack story.

options.title: Threat Narrative Graph and Counter-Pressure Protocol
options.summary: Create one owner for event provenance, bounded scam-playbook alignment, counterfactuals and safe interruption.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Adds attack-path, counterfactual and intervention ownership while retaining existing safeguards.
Differentiates SCAMTRACE from generic local classification without claiming exclusivity.

tradeoffs.assessment: Unsafe action and evidence chain become explicit rather than implied by score contribution.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Assert every high-risk scenario yields direct action, chain or both.

tradeoffs.assessment: A bounded scan adds CPU work proportional to session segment limits.
Stores compact evidence references already present in the ephemeral session.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure RSS at bounded session capacity.

tradeoffs.assessment: Deterministic intervention survives unavailable language or voice components.
Structured playbook and protocol fields make QA concrete but require taxonomy governance.
Additive response fields preserve current ASR and fusion components.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Keep existing API consumers working with optional fields.

residualRisks: Bounded playbooks can miss novel coercion patterns.

options.title: On-device semantic foundation model
options.summary: Add a locally deployed multilingual semantic model with a signed model lifecycle and shadow-mode gate.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Semantic coverage may improve but cannot establish safety without independent evaluation.

tradeoffs.assessment: May broaden paraphrases but adds model supply-chain and output-governance risks.
Local semantic inference is likely heavier than the JSON baseline.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure p95 segment latency and thermal impact.

tradeoffs.assessment: Model artifact and runtime increase storage and RAM.
Failure and abstention behavior need explicit design.
Adds signed updates, compatibility matrix and release governance.
New runtime must start in shadow mode.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Keep deterministic policy as alert authority.

opportunities.recommendation: Use the structural narrative-and-protocol option now. Keep the foundation-model route in shadow-mode research until target-language field validation and device budgets exist.

openQuestions: Which consent and OS integration model can expose live phone-call audio on Android?
Can we obtain consented, de-identified Indian-language real-call data with an ethics and retention protocol?
Which validated anti-spoofing checkpoint meets licence and local-latency requirements?
